goals.3: Question words: Wer, Was, Wo, Woher, Wie
dialog.1.de.6.n: Male: Bangladescher. Like professions, no ein comes before it
grammar.0.title: Country: where from? where?
grammar.0.note: Most countries have no article. Exceptions (with article): die Schweiz, die Türkei, die USA.
grammar.1.title: Nationality: male and female
grammar.1.note: In most cases the female form = the male form + -in. When speaking, leave out the article: „Ich bin Bangladescher.“
grammar.2.title: Question words (W-Fragen)
grammar.2.note: In W-questions the verb is in second place: Woher | kommst | du? — the question word takes first place.
quiz.3.why: To say where you come from: aus Deutschland.
quiz.4.why: To say where you live: in Berlin.
quiz.5.prompt: What do you call a Bangladeshi woman?
quiz.7.prompt: Put the words in order: “I live in Berlin now.”
